lines: Third-quarter 2026 revenue was RMB 783.70 million, up 1.65% year over year versus the restated comparable quarter.
Third-quarter net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 29.54 million, narrowing from a restated RMB 51.13 million loss a year earlier.
First nine months 2026 revenue was RMB 2.150 billion, up 11.98% year over year versus restated figures; attributable net loss was RMB 187.04 million.
First nine months operating cash flow was positive RMB 449.82 million versus negative RMB 419.30 million in the restated prior-year period.
The official third-quarter report is unaudited; no exact-time investor call has been verified. Do not create a timed calendar event from the report release date.
